facts.raw_span: A 29-year-old primigravida woman at 41+2 weeks of pregnancy
No history of gestational diabetes mellitus, preeclampsia, or coagulation disorders
no anti-coagulation therapy with heparin
Intraoperative blood loss was 400 mL
Right lower limb showed full recovery of sensation and muscle strength
Left lower limb showed mild soreness and swelling with manual muscle testing (MMT) grade of 2
Hypesthesia below chest level developed, followed by reduction in muscle strength of both lower limbs, progressing to flaccid paralysis
Platelet count: 157 × 10^9/L
Hemoglobin: 132 g/L
Space-occupying lesion at left epidural site of T2-3 (12 × 10 × 30 mm)
Spinal compression with rightward shift
Confirmed presence of vascular malformation
